You will need: Answer booklet (enclosed)
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
Follow the instructions on the front cover of the answer booklet. If you need additional answer paper,
ask the invigilator for a continuation booklet.
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
DEPTH STUDY A: THE FIRST WORLD WAR, 1914–18
1 How important was the Battle of Jutland (1916) in the war at sea? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was the Hindenburg Line to the course of the war on the Western Front? Explain
your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY B: GERMANY, 1918–45
How important were the military restrictions in the Treaty of Versailles as a cause of instability in
Germany, 1919–23? Explain your answer.
How significant was the Enabling Act (1933) in allowing Hitler to establish a dictatorship in Germany
by 1934? Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY C: RUSSIA, 1905–41
How important was Stolypin in bringing about stability in Russia after the 1905 Revolution? Explain
your answer. [40]
How significant was the Kronstadt Rising in ensuring the continuance of Bolshevik rule after 1921?
Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY D: THE UNITED STATES, 1919–41
How important was the Scopes ‘Monkey Trial’ as an aspect of intolerance in the USA in the 1920s?
Explain your answer.
How significant was Huey Long in opposition to the New Deal after 1933? Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY E: CHINA, c.1930–c.1990
How important was the Shanghai Massacre (1927) to the development of the Chinese Communist
Party? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was propaganda in shaping the lives of the Chinese people after 1949? Explain
your answer.
DEPTH STUDY F: SOUTH AFRICA, c.1940–c.1994
How important were restrictions on political rights as an aspect of racial discrimination before 1948?
Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was support from Afrikaners to the maintenance of apartheid after 1948? Explain
your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY G: ISRAELIS AND PALESTINIANS SINCE 1945
How important were Jewish resistance movements in Palestine to the creation of Israel in 1948?
Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was the creation of the Palestinian Authority (1994) in the Arab–Israeli peace
process? Explain your answer.
